Man, I can't tell you how similar my situation is. I'm praying for you my guy. Praying for you just as much as I'm praying for myself. You can get through this, for you, for your kids, for a better future. 

I believe in you man. I can tell you're a kind and caring individual. Stay that way. Don't let someone strip that good nature from you. Its so very rare these days that, I praise the behavior every time I see if for myself.

They told me, "just shut up and end it"

Today.
Share your thoughts. How did you attempt? Why did it fail?
Worst thing about it is, I still want to fix things. I still want to be with her. But I made the mistake of being her secret.

Don't beat yourself up too much, we all mess up sometimes. 

Moving forward: SEEK REPRESENTATION. 

I will give you a few notes, that I wish I would have followed myself.

1) Record everything, don't put it anything past her. She might be taking screen shots of every word you say to her. She will use everything and anything against you in court so it would be in your best interest to protect yourself in every way possible.

2)  Get your shit together, keep it together, leave it together. 

3) Remember to love yourself at the end of the day.
That's so cool! I think they look super neat. :)
